verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a note-taking app, but the evidence documents no first-party AI assistant in Obsidian. The only AI mentions are third-party community plugins (Text-Generator, Copilot) and a headless Sync client described as useful for agents. These are adjacent workarounds, not a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
